Burlington: catchment and schedule depth bind before gates. Expansion is speculative without demand.
Bangor: non-hub primary; demand-bound. Terminal renovation does not unlock a large passenger surplus.
Worcester Regional: thin commercial schedule; demand-bound inside the Boston CBSA.
